prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
sign_in, copy changes were consistently helpful, winning 4 out of 5 tests (+3.0% average after noise correction).
adoption, redesign changes were helpful in 2 out of 4 tests (+2.3% average after noise correction), while the other 2 showed no clear effect.
finish, new_screen changes failed to sustain early success, with later tests showing no clear effect or performing worse (-1.3% average).
home, wait_info, home, notification, sign_in, hint, and adoption, layout changes consistently showed no clear effect across 2 tests each.
home, new_flow, finish, redesign, and choose_path, copy changes resulted in no clear effect or worse performance across multiple tests.
Predictions were consistently too optimistic overall, and categories with only 1 test provide thin evidence.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, copy] Existing Pet Restoration Sign-In Headline: Update the sign-in screen headline and body text to reassure users that signing in restores and protects all previously adopted pets. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Carousel Layout Pet Creation Redesign: Redesign the photo upload step using a interactive carousel layout to guide users through custom pet creation visuals. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failing or producing bad visual results, contributing to low 70.3% adoption conversion.)
2: [sign_in, redesign] Centered Account Authentication Layout: Redesign the sign-in screen into a focused centered layout emphasizing cloud sync and pet data recovery. (why: 8 emails reported missing pets on re-login and 2 emails noted sign-in loading issues.)
3: [finish, copy] Desktop Pet Interaction Controls Copy: Update the home intro text with explicit instructions on dragging, double-clicking, and right-clicking to manage the pet. (why: 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.)
4: [adoption, new_screen] Custom Pet Preview Verification Screen: Insert a new verification screen after photo upload so users can inspect and approve their pet preview before finalizing. (why: Custom pet rendering issues caused support tickets and dropped adoption completion to 70.3%.)
5: [choose_path, redesign] Card Layout Path Selection Redesign: Redesign the choose path screen with a structured card layout comparing instant adoption vs custom generation. (why: Users take a long mean time of 514s on the choose path screen.)
6: [sign_in, hint] Automatic Pet Sync Account Hint: Add a hint explaining how cloud authentication preserves pets across sessions and device reinstalls. (why: 8 support messages detailed lost or reset pets when signing in again.)
7: [home, wait_info] Desktop Engine Initialization Status Display: Enable progress bar and time estimation on the waiting screen while desktop components load. (why: The waiting step has a long median time of 201s / mean 2336s, and 3 emails reported pets failing to appear.)
8: [finish, hint] Tray Menu & Shortcut Desktop Pet Hint: Display a hint on the finish screen explaining how to access pet controls via the system tray icon. (why: 7 support emails mentioned confusion or desktop feature issues after setup.)
